claims.text: The hotel faces Lake Geneva, minutes from the parks and boutiques of rue du Rhône.

findings.quote: Facing Lake Geneva and minutes from the parks and boutiques of rue du Rhône

claims.text: The hotel has a prime lakefront location within walking distance of the city center, in a very peaceful area.

findings.quote: At once at a walking distance to the city center and at the same time on a very peaceful area, Hotel President Wilson, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Geneva, benefits from a prime lakefront location.

claims.text: The hotel is close to international organizations including the UN, as well as diplomatic missions and consulates.

findings.quote: Conveniently located close to the most recognized Swiss factories, international organizations including the UN, OMS, OMC, OMPI, diplomatic missions and consulates

claims.text: The hotel was designed by architect and hotelier Marcel Jacquignon and first opened in 1962.

findings.quote: Designed by architect and hotelier Marcel Jacquignon, Hotel President opened its doors for the first time on May 18, 1962.

claims.text: It reopened in 1996 as Hotel President Wilson, named in honor of Woodrow Wilson, the 28th President of the United States.

findings.quote: The hotel reopened in 1996 as the new Hotel President Wilson, in honor of the 28th President of the United States of America, Woodrow Wilson

claims.text: Public areas are characterized by three themes conceived by South Korean artist Jae-Hyo Lee: water, surrounding landscape and light.

findings.quote: renovation process covering public areas and characterized by three main themes conceptualized by South-Korean artist Jae-Hyo Lee: water, surrounding landscape and light.

claims.text: Bathrooms are marble, with Byredo bath amenities.

findings.quote: marble bathrooms feature ByRedo bath amenities

claims.text: Rooms have twice-daily housekeeping.

findings.quote: our twice-daily housekeeping service ensures guests are always in impeccably tidy surroundings

claims.text: Spa body treatments include scrubs, massages, foot reflexology, lymphatic drainage and a hammam ritual.

findings.quote: The spa offers a wide range of body treatments including scrubs, massages, foot reflexology, lymphatic drainage and hammam ritual.

claims.text: A Tom Ford beauty boutique is located at the hotel.

findings.quote: Tom Ford beauty welcomes you every day in its Geneva boutique, located at Hotel President Wilson.

claims.text: Bayview offers a seasonal menu of locally sourced products with views of Lake Geneva and the Alps.

findings.quote: The Chef presents a seasonal menu crafted from locally sourced products, offering an authentic gastronomic experience paired with stunning views of Lake Geneva and the Alps.

claims.text: Arabesque serves traditional Lebanese cuisine in an oriental setting.

findings.quote: The famous Lebanese Arabesque restaurant invites you for a culinary journey in an oriental setting. The cuisine is firstly authentic and pure, carried out the traditional flavors from Lebanon.

claims.text: The hotel has the first spa in Switzerland to feature La Mer skincare products and Signature treatments.

findings.quote: The Hotel President Wilson boasts the first Spa in Switzerland to feature the prestigious and sought-after La Mer skincare products and Signature treatments.

claims.text: The Royal Penthouse Floor stretches across the entire 8th floor.

findings.quote: Succumb to the ultimate luxury of our Royal Penthouse Floor, stretching on the entire 8th floor, namely 1,680 sqm.

claims.text: The heated outdoor pool is on the first-floor terrace and overlooks Lake Geneva, the Alps and the Mont Blanc range.

findings.quote: Enjoy a leisurely swim or simply relax on a deck chair at the hotel’s heated outdoor swimming pool. Located on the first-floor terrace, our soothing swimming pool overlooks Lake Geneva and the panoramic Alps and Mont Blanc range

claims.text: A private Spa Suite with steam room, sauna and relaxing area is available exclusively with spa packages.

findings.quote: Enjoy the ultimate privilege of our Spa Suite including, steam room, sauna and relaxing area, available exclusively with our Spa packages.

claims.text: Suites have floor-to-ceiling windows with views of the lake, pool and city.

findings.quote: Luxury suites in Geneva feature floor-to-ceiling windows with views of the lake, pool, and city.

claims.text: The swimming pool is open during summertime, not year-round.

findings.quote: The swimming pool is only open during summertime from May to September.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes ultra-luxury pricing that reflects the premium Geneva location.
WhataHotel notes the formal atmosphere may not suit all travelers.
